out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Paper towels not provided at handsink located at main cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Paper towels provided.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Whole chicken (125F) and cut chicken (117F) observed in 1 Dr Hot unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Chicken discarded and replaced with newly cooked chicken.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The handle to open the rice cooker was observed in poor repair. The side cover of the rotisserie oven observed off of the unit, PIC stated it was taken off for maintenance.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. -Repair or replace handle on rice cooker. -Repair or replace side of rotisserie oven.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces in squirt bottles in 2 Dr prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS discussed labeling containers with PIC.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for garlic were observed reused for the storage of house made sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS discussed container usage with PIC.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3 VAT SINK piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Manager present stated maintenance has already been called for repairs.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Whole chicken (126F) and cut chicken (118F) observed in chicken hot box. Hot box observed with gasket in poor repair.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated chicken is only held for 2 hours and new batch is made.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are (missing, damaged): Gasket observed in poor repair on the Chicken hot holding box.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. PIC stated new gasket has been ordered by the owner.
